usedFor: LinkedIn Campaign Manager captures leads and MSG91 mails them, so “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” runs “Send a Mail”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sponsored Lead Form Response” in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Each ad lead gets a templated email from your MSG91 account.

watchOut: That email reaches someone outside, so it waits in Needs you for approval before it goes.
